response.sql: WITH groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, employee_count * 1.0 / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM groups) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC LIMIT 10
